'''Tregga''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[Chak-root]] [[smuggler]] from [[Oslumpex V]] during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. In [[10 BBY]], He was on the ice-covered [[planet]] [[Vandor]],<ref name="SoloOG" /> where he was present in the [[Cantina|saloon]] known as [[the Lodge]] when the [[human]] outlaws [[Han Solo]] and [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] first met over a [[Gambling|game]] of [[sabacc]].<ref name="Solo">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref>

==Biography==
At some point Tregga became a regular customer at [[the Lodge]]. He would go on to perform several jobs with [[Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca]]. At some point, he began to believe that Solo was lying about his childhood. It was Tregga's belief that Han was actually raised by wandering [[The galaxy|galactic]] [[Merchant|traders]], going so far as to speculate that Han had been present at [[Kashyyyk]] when the [[Galactic Republic]] [[Battle of Kashyyyk|fought]] the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatists]] there during the [[Clone Wars]], which led to Han being a constant companion of Chewbacca ever since. Tregga relayed these theories to the Lodge's bartender [[Tivoche Bilure|Midnight]].<ref name="TFV" />

Midnight however, raised doubt about these theories. This was mainly due to Tregga's reputation of using brain implants which were known to calculate probabilities incorrectly, to the point that [[Gambling|gamblers]] at the Lodge had come to anticipate it every time he was seen, despite Tregga being unaware of this particular blind spot.<ref name="TFV" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tregga first appeared in the [[2018]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|Anthology]] film, ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''<ref name="Solo" /> and was first identified in the accompanying reference book ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="SoloOG" />
